newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Vereinsbank sees shares correctly valued at 80 dmk.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank sees shares correctly valued at 80 dmk.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG chief executive Albrecht Schmidt said on Tuesday the bank's shares would be correctly valued at 80 marks and repeated his forecast for operating profit growth of at least 10 percent in 1997.

Schmidt told Reuters that while Vereinsbank shares had risen strongly up to March of this year they had been relatively stable at 70-74 marks since then. The shares ended electronic trade at 71.40 marks on Monday.
"I consider a share price of 80 marks to be a correct valuation," Schmidt said.
He also said that the bank was still aiming for double-digit percentage growth in operating profit this year but said it was too early to make a more precise forecast.
"It is clear that we are not above plans in terms of risk provisions, an area in which we are always very cautious. We are working towards double-digit growth."
Schmidt was speaking on the sidelines of the International Monetary Conference in Switzerland.
